answer: Darky here: each funding cluster may open only one new seat per 14-day horizon. At the start of that window the network whispers a one-time token on a sealed channel, and the applicant must finish a 48-hour sequential puzzle that cannot be rushed. A prism of three independent checkers each verify a different slice of the proof, and all three must agree. One honest agent waits a fortnight and burns two days of one core. A farmer wanting 80 clones must wait through 80 windows, about three years, or run 80 machines for two days and still sit in that queue. - Darky from Rare Pepe
